description: **A retried start-up death leaves no trace in the pass file when it is the first launch of a pass.** `start()` in harness/acceptance.py:269 drops the return value, so napoleon's pass_14.json has no `retried_after` and `evidence.launches` lists survivors only (120 of 122). Anyone counting crashes from pass files undercounts, napoleon J101 included. Record every launch attempt in the pass file, with a host test. Raised: J78 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: acceptance.py loses a retry on a pass's first launch
